def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==1}
    def nei(p):
        r,c=p
        return [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)] if (r+dr,c+dc) in pts]
    ends=[p for p in pts if len(nei(p))==1]
    free=[p for p in ends if p[0] not in (0,R-1) and p[1] not in (0,C-1)]
    r,c=free[0]
    pr,pc=nei((r,c))[0]
    dr,dc=r-pr,c-pc
    while True:
        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
        if not (0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C): break
        if g[nr][nc]==2:
            dr=-dr
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not (0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C): break
        g[nr][nc]=1
        r,c=nr,nc
    return g

base=Path('/home/USER/runs/paper/kimi-moonshot-arc2-hpl0/stream/frozen/seen-p1/play/users/u062/system/state/workspace/programs')

program='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows, cols = len(g), len(g[0])
    points = {(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if g[r][c] == 1}

    def neighbors(point):
        r, c = point
        return [(r + dr, c + dc)
                for dr, dc in [(-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)]
                if (r + dr, c + dc) in points]

    endpoints = [p for p in points if len(neighbors(p)) == 1]
    free = [p for p in endpoints
            if p[0] not in (0, rows - 1) and p[1] not in (0, cols - 1)]
    r, c = free[0]
    pr, pc = neighbors((r, c))[0]
    dr, dc = r - pr, c - pc

    while True:
        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
        if not (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols):
            break
        if g[nr][nc] == 2:
            dr = -dr
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if not (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols):
                break
        g[nr][nc] = 1
        r, c = nr, nc
    return g
'''
